texts.text: Finai tor Publication #22831-T1 Substitute Narrative - 1120 N Chestnut Chicago IL Type 1 from RT-4 to RM-5 The property is owned by the applicants Julie and Daniel Castaneda. They desire to build a new home as this current structure is antiquated. The applicant intends to demolish the existing structure and construct a new three (3) dwelling units, with (2) on-site parking spaces and a driveway accessible from Chestnut Street. To accommodate the bulk and density standards associated with a new construction 3 dwelling unit residential building. There is no alley at the property. The lot is not standard it measures 26.5 by 114.50 by 29.17 (on an angle) and 102.34. (a) Floor Area ratio = 4793.4/2873.1 = 1.66 (b) Density (lot area per dwelling unit) = 2873.1 (c) Off street parking = 2 off street (d) Setbacks = 2.1 feet on the west, 3.0 feet on the east, rear set back of 26.1 feet and front set back 7.69 (e) Building Heights = 37 ft 10.5 inches A variation is being sought to reduce the off-street parking requirement of 3 spaces in the RM-5 Zoning District to 2 per Section 17-13-1101-C of the Chicago Zoning Code. Applicant will seek all relief as needed for the attached plans, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code. It is near the Chicago Ave and Milwaukee Ave bus line and the TSL is the Chicago Ave Blue Line train station.
